long_biography.plain_text:
The Sklavenitis family chose continuity over a sale in 2006, when Maria Sklavenitou and her siblings acquired the interests of other founding branches. She became chair while Gerasimos and Stelios Sklavenitis took executive management roles.

Expansion followed through the purchase of regional supermarket chains and Makro Greece. The defining transaction came in 2017, when the group absorbed the viable operations of Marinopoulos across Greece and Cyprus. Sklavenitou has remained chair through the integration and subsequent growth. She also chairs an agricultural-processing company established to produce and package nuts, spices and legumes.
